title: Kioxia and SanDisk to Invest About ¥5 Trillion in Japan, Boosting Flash Memory Output for AI Demand
excerpt: Kioxia and SanDisk to invest about ¥5 trillion in Japan, boosting flash memory output for AI demand. Kioxia and US-based SanDisk have announced a plan to invest a total of about ¥5 trillion (more than US$31 billion) in their flash memory business in Japan by 2032 [...]
